title: Canvas: the bands from main, the player and judge prompts, one trial game on Sonnet and play.md, the CLAUDE.md lines
why: Open 4, New 3, Miss 3, Reach 1 = 11: opus medium. Where the bands sit is found by searching main's numbers and a perturbation; the prompts and whether a model can play from the view are judged only by the trial; nothing like a model-as-player exists here. Reach 1: the bands gate CI for every later piece. About 8 files, 400 lines of prompts, bands and records, plus easel fixes. A canvas at 11 holds the hard part, as the shape expects. The trial's player and judge run as Agent-tool subagents on Sonnet, not nested claude -p, which isn't logged in inside a Relay session (spec-review, probe.md); their tokens and minutes are what the Agent tool reports, and the points are this step's own.

title: Review the piece
why: The piece's goal is judged by play (the trial game and whether its view is enough to play), so Opus by the rule, at medium: the crew's checkSteps refuses a judging step at low effort. It reruns check.sh, compare.sh and sweep --judge, plays twenty turns through sansfiat play and judges them, reads play.md and bands.md, adds items 1, 4 and 9 to vision.md's Decided ledger, and answers the question in the PR description.
